description: Concordance des personnes et des temps, types de phrases au style indirect.

questions.question: Peter Jennings said he would visit the factory as soon as he …… released from hospital.
questions.explication: Verbe introductif au prétérit, subordonnée de temps : on ne peut pas mettre de futur ni de conditionnel, on met le prétérit `was`.

questions.question: They were sure that after his long and tiring walk in the woods, the gardener …… a nap when they arrived.
questions.explication: Subordonnée de temps au prétérit → complétive au conditionnel présent : `would be having`.

questions.question: Mrs. Woodrige asked us what time we …… we would bring the bulk goods.
questions.explication: La première complétive étant au conditionnel, la seconde peut être au prétérit : `thought`.

questions.question: Paul Hutchinson declared that as long as the survey had not been finished he …… any information.
questions.explication: Subordonnée de temps au pluperfect → complétive au conditionnel : `would not release`.

questions.question: Joe Stevens wonders whether anybody …… that information on time.
questions.explication: Proposition principale au présent → complétive au futur : `will ever get`.

questions.question: They were sorry to hear that the drought …… many crops in the region.
questions.explication: Principale au prétérit → complétive au pluperfect (l'action d'entendre est postérieure à la sécheresse) : `had damaged`.

questions.question: The real estate agent advised the landlord to install a fitted kitchen so that the rental …… faster.
questions.explication: Principale au prétérit → complétive au conditionnel présent : `could be done`.

questions.question: The sales representative apologizes about bringing the wrong samples and promises he …… the right ones next time.
questions.explication: Principale au présent, subordonnée qui se termine par *next time* : futur `will bring`.

questions.question: The captain regretted that the propeller …… during the competition and added he would come back next year with a brand new ship.
questions.explication: Principale au prétérit → pluperfect, le regret étant postérieur à la casse : `had broken`.

questions.question: The children had always thought Santa Claus …… them another board game.
questions.explication: Principale au pluperfect → un conditionnel est envisageable dans la complétive : `should have brought`.
